title: Apple is expected to focus on ‘budget-minded’ products in February and March.
summary: During the iOS 27.4 cycle, which runs between February and March, Apple plans to focus on its budget-minded products and debut an updated low-end iPad, iPhone 18e and new MacBook Neo, I’m told.
